name: small document fits in one chunk
new body chunk repeats active headers
input: second paragraph starts a new chunk inside # Guide / ## Install
test:
md = '# Guide

## Install

First paragraph.

Second paragraph.'
assert chunk_markdown(md, 40) == [
    '# Guide

## Install

First paragraph.',
    '# Guide
## Install

Second paragraph.',
]

name: heading stack updates by level
input: sibling sections B and C under A
test:
md = '# A

## B

b text

## C

c text'
chunks = chunk_markdown(md, 30)
assert chunks[-1].startswith('# A
## C

')
assert '## B' not in chunks[-1]

name: ignores heading-looking lines inside fenced code
test:
md = '# Real

```python
# fake
```

Body text'
chunks = chunk_markdown(md, 30)
assert chunks[-1] == '# Real

Body text'

name: normalizes CRLF and splits oversized paragraphs with context
input: long body under a heading with CRLF newlines
test:
chunks = chunk_markdown('# A

abcdefghij', 10)
assert chunks == ['# A

abcde', '# A

fghij']
assert all(len(chunk) <= 10 for chunk in chunks)
